sectors.name: Technology
themes: AI-driven memory and semiconductor supercycle continues to re-rate Korean and global chip leaders, pulling Indonesian tech sentiment higher via supply-chain linkages.

Local tech listings are outperforming US peers on relative valuation catch-up, supported by domestic liquidity and government digitalization push, making ID tech a tactical alpha source.
sectors.ai: Buy Indonesian tech exposure via local listings and US-listed proxies; momentum is broad and durable, led by memory/semis (SK Hynix, Samsung) and e-commerce/logistics (MLPT, AMZN, IRSX). The +1.85% ID outperformance vs +0.61% US signals domestic capital rotation into tech, not just global beta. Add on any dip toward +1.0% intraday, targeting 3-5% upside over 2 weeks.

Formal retail channel expansion in tier-2/3 cities is accelerating, benefiting mid-cap staples UNIC and GZCO over the next 12 months.
sectors.ai: Buy consumer staples selectively on IDX strength: IATA, SGRO, and AGAR show momentum from rural demand and palm-oil-linked FMCG input leverage. Rotate out of US-exposed names (INDR, BACH) as IDR strength and domestic consumption hold. Target UNIC and OPMS for defensive yield; trim GZCO on valuation risk.

Trim RGAS and PACK into strength—no fundamental catalyst. Hold core infrastructure exposure, add only on pullbacks to support.
